Select activity_id, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id as molecule_chembl_id, target_dictionary.chembl_id as target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name as target_name, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units. Join activities with molecule_dictionary on molregno and with assays on assay_id and with target_dictionary on tid. Filter target_dictionary.organism to 'Homo sapiens', target_type to 'SINGLE PROTEIN', standard_units to 'nM', standard_type to EC50/IC50/AC50, and standard_value below 50. Return distinct rows. Sort by activity_id ascending. Limit to 200.
